summary_en: Convano Inc. resolved to cancel 3,728,960 treasury shares (7.3% of issued shares before cancellation) acquired from Dimensional Inc. on October 21, 2026. The cancellation will take effect on November 30, 2026, reducing issued shares to 47,186,640.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Shares (Progress of Disclosure Matters)
translation_en_brief:
On November 13, 2026, Convano Inc.'s Board of Directors resolved to cancel 3,728,960 treasury shares acquired from Dimensional Inc. on October 21, 2026, pursuant to Article 178 of the Companies Act. These shares represent 7.3% of issued shares (on a pre-cancellation basis). The cancellation will become effective on November 30, 2026, reducing the total issued shares to 47,186,640. The company's shares were acquired through private negotiation at a total price of ¥3,728,960,000.

The cancellation proceeds from the company's stated policy to return funds to shareholders efficiently. Shares necessary to fulfill odd-lot purchase requests under the odd-lot sale system will be retained from existing treasury stock (52,010 shares) rather than the acquired shares. After cancellation, the company will hold 52,010 treasury shares, with issued shares excluding treasury stock totaling 47,134,630.

The company notes that this cancellation is a reclassification within the equity section of the balance sheet and will have no impact on consolidated results for the fiscal year ending March 2027. A separate market purchase program initiated on August 24, 2026 (with an execution deadline of March 31, 2027) remains ongoing; decisions regarding cancellation of shares acquired through that program will be disclosed separately.
